title: STUTTER -- glitchy stereo stutter / beat-repeat effect

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Audio starts when the patch opens.
INPUT toggle: off = live input 1-2, on = sound file.
Open File: choose a sound file. It starts playing right away. Loop repeats it.
STUTTER toggle (top left): engages the effect. The light shows when it is on.
Waveform: the last 4 s of input. The highlighted region is the slice being repeated.
BPM (20-300) and Division (1/4 to 1/64, dotted, triplets, quintuplets, septuplets):
together they set the slice length. Changes take effect at once.
Slice: shortens the slice within the division (0.1-1).
Pitch: playback rate, 0.5 (one octave down) to 2 (one octave up).
Chaos: blends from strict rhythmic repeats to random slice start, length and rate.
Feedback: feeds the output back into the recording buffer (up to 0.95).
Dry/Wet: balance of the original and the stuttered sound.
IN / OUT meters: input and output level.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: gen~ stutter-engine records the input into a 4 s stereo buffer all the time.
Two playback voices take turns, with about 5 ms crossfades, so every change is click-free.
gen~ brickwall-limiter after the engine keeps feedback from blowing up.
